title: Prove the final Foundation gate

gates.name: Configured Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Configured Python tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest

evidence_required: Fresh redacted outputs and exit codes for every required gate.
Independent mapping from REQ-000 and each Foundation verification target to concrete command/probe evidence.
Effective topology, image identity, migration/pgvector, imports, readiness, storage/restart and cleanup evidence under .tasks/TASK-002-T2-FT-000-W0/.
A verifier-owned outcome probe and VERDICT: PASS before the explicit owner or Foundation scheduler closes the gate.
purpose: Independently determine whether the completed walking skeleton satisfies every accepted Foundation exit target before product task design.
success_outcome: A fresh isolated verification run proves build, typecheck, tests, one-image/three-role startup, empty-database migration, pgvector, private topology, OpenCV/InsightFace imports, fake-engine HTTPS readiness, storage persistence across restart and owned cleanup, with no source or runtime repair performed by the gate.
anti_goals: Do not implement, repair or reconfigure the walking skeleton inside this final gate.
Do not add product behavior, schemas, endpoints, auth, production certificates or deployment actions.
Do not treat prior implementation receipts as sufficient independent PASS evidence.

forbidden_scope: Application source, build, migration, Compose or HTTPS-edge repair
Product feature implementation or specification expansion
Operator/default persistent data or non-test external resources
stop_conditions: Any required command or verification target fails or cannot produce independently grounded evidence.
Passing the gate would require changing source, runtime configuration, a canonical spec or accepted architecture.
The smoke run is not isolated from existing operator/default Compose resources.
REQ-000 or the named Foundation exit criteria no longer match the implemented baseline.

constraints: This is the only final Foundation gate and it depends on every required implementation task.
The gate is verification-only: failures are reported and routed back; they are not repaired in this task.
Use a fresh unique Compose project with disposable test resources and preserve operator/default volumes.
Independent verification must ground every REQ-000 and executable-baseline claim rather than relying only on implementation receipts.
invariants: No application source or runtime configuration changes are allowed to turn a failing gate into a pass.
Only the non-production HTTPS edge may be host-published during the isolated run.
Probe data and Compose cleanup target only resources created by this gate.
A non-zero or incomplete probe prevents VERDICT: PASS and Foundation closure.
verification_targets: Independently rerun and map all build, mypy, pytest, topology, migration, import, readiness, storage, restart and cleanup claims.
Confirm the implementation contains no product tables/endpoints/state, empty future slices, real-model execution or production deployment machinery.
Record one fresh verifier-owned outcome probe in addition to any eligible implementation evidence.
